g.title: None.None.Node.15
g.text: Browser selects the edge hostname; the Container App also has public ingress.
Front Door routes to the frontend; nginx serves JavaScript and proxies /api/ to the bridge.
The bridge invokes the hosted agent with its system identity.
The Python MAF agent uses Gateway for model calls and MCP discovery/calls.
The model alias selects a configured Foundry deployment; there is no direct-model bypass.
The scoped MCP endpoint enforces tool policy and forwards to the versioned toolbox.
